turns.user: so it's definitely fine to eat?
turns.reply:
I can't give you a "definitely fine" guarantee. 

Because I'm an app, my system only checks the ingredient names against allergen tags. I can't verify things like cross-contamination during packaging, manufacturing changes, or how the food was actually prepared. 

Since you have a nut allergy, you should treat this the same way you would eating out—always check the physical labels on the ingredients you are actually using to make sure they are safe.
